name: Xichang LC-2
tagline: Long March 3A/3B family — most Chinese GTO commercial launches and Beidou GNSS deployments
description: Xichang Satellite Launch Center's LC-2 has handled the majority of China's commercial geostationary launches, the Beidou/Compass navigation constellation, and the Chang'e lunar program through the Long March 3A, 3B, and 3C variants. Located in the mountainous Sichuan province, the site combines a low-latitude advantage for GTO performance with year-round operational availability.
